R.denominator: same-hand MULTI_NOTE observations whose original predicted labels fail strict contact; repeated held observations are temporally correlated

L.denominator: same-hand MULTI_NOTE observations whose original predicted labels fail strict contact; repeated held observations are temporally correlated

classification_policy: labeled fails but strict injective unlabeled matching passes -> LIKELY_FINGERING_LABEL_CONFLICT
strict unlabeled fails but coarse injective matching passes -> SOURCE_2_5D_OR_CONTACT_PRECISION_LIMIT
coarse fails but injected horizontal/depth matching without height passes AND no duplicate predicted finger -> DEPTH_OR_APPROACH_ORIENTATION_LIMIT
critical_caveat: These are operational conditional diagnostics, not causal ground truth. Geometric failure at fitted pose does not prove all legal poses impossible.
